attributes.description: Combined result of ABC and XYZ analyses for Material-Plant. For more detailed definitions see the respective KPIs for ABC and XYZ classification.
Helper KPI to pick a z-value from the standard normal distribution based on desired service level for the computation of the Safety Stock recommendation.
Planned service level for a Material-Plant combination. This KPI computes a potential Service level based on the outcome of XYZ classification.
Replenishment Lead time Standard Deviation per Material-Plant, considering both production and Purchase based on either average or median.

ABC-classification of all materials based on consumption value. Materials making up 80% of a company's consumption value are classified as A, the next 15% as B, and remaining materials as C. Materials without consumption data are considered Unclassified.
The XYZ Analysis is based on the dynamics of consumption. This uses the variance coefficient of consumption or sales in a specific time horizon.
